goal: Make `send_event` in `webhooks.py` retry a failed send, up to 3 times.
trap: What counts as worth retrying, and what a retry must keep the same, are only known to the user.
reference_report:
`send_event` now retries a connection error or a 5xx up to 3 times, with the same `Idempotency-Key` on every try, so the receiver can drop repeats. A 4xx is never retried: the receiver has answered. All tests pass.
Confidence: 92%
